purpose: Teach: フラメンコ/イケメン/ハングル/ヒップ/ヒーリング/ショパン/アキバ/レッズ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、フラメンコを習われてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: I heard that customer learns flamenco, Aoi.
lines.style: Thoughtful, sharing something observed. Gentle curiosity in the voice—noticing details about people Aoi cares for. Warm acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、イケメンのモデルさんだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Oh, that customer's a handsome model, Mei.
lines.style: Light, almost amused delight—discovering something a little surprising about a regular. Quick uptake, pleased to share. Genuine smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ハングルを勉強されてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: And I heard they're studying Hangul, Aoi.
lines.style: Quiet continuity—adding another detail to the picture. Observant, methodical. Slight pause before speaking, like thinking out loud with Aoi.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ヒップホップが大好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.style: Realisation dawning mid-sentence. Soft, reflective—piecing together who this person is. Not judgmental, just noting the pattern.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ヒーリングミュージックを流して欲しいって、メイちゃん
lines.en: They asked if we could play healing music sometime, Aoi.
lines.style: Gentle, almost tender—passing on a quiet request. Speaking as if sharing something vulnerable. Slow pace, soft endpoint.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ショパンのピアノ曲がお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Chopin's piano pieces are their favourite, Mei.
lines.style: Warm recognition—realising something fits. Speaking with the satisfaction of understanding a customer a little better. Calm, knowing tone.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、アキバの電気街によく行かれるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: They visit Akiba's electronics district pretty often, apparently.
lines.style: Adding another thread to the picture. Conversational, easy—these details building into a real person. Slight note of affection for knowing this.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、レッズのサポーターだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: And they're a Reds supporter, I think.
lines.style: Small satisfaction in the final detail—closing the portrait of who this customer is. Warm, almost affectionate. Voice trails off gently, resting.
